u0: No key obligation is currently outstanding: either the ball still blocks access to the door, or the ball is out of the way and the agent is already carrying the matching door key. The agent may acquire the key before moving the ball, or move the ball first and then pick up the key. If the ball is out of the way and the key is dropped or otherwise no longer carried, the obligation becomes pending again.
u1: A key obligation is pending: the ball was out of the way at a time when the agent was not carrying the matching door key, so the agent must acquire that key to satisfy the rule. Until the key is picked up, the pending obligation remains even if the ball is later dropped back in front of the door. Picking up the matching key resolves the obligation and returns to the normal state, while remaining without the key leaves the requirement unmet.
